slug: 2026-02-20 Libya to reactivate One-Stop Shop for company registration (Commercial Registry Authority)
note: The meeting discussed activating the One-Stop Shop and reviewed digital readiness; it does not say a counter has opened, records are being digitised or online registration is in service.

The meeting discussed linking registry systems to the General Information Authority via the National Number; no digital register, online registration, shared firm number or beneficial owners are stated.

facts.fact: The Libya Observer reports the economy minister and the head of the Commercial Registry Authority reviewed the electronic system for the commercial registry, including integration of data on public, private and joint companies and foreign branches.
facts.system: electronic system for the commercial registry

facts.fact: The Libya Herald reports a UNCTAD-built e-single window for company registration, of which online trade-name search is the first of seven procedures, is being developed with EU and Expertise France support.
The Libya Herald reports the Tripoli Ministry of Economy launched its electronic commercial (company) registry system, linked to regional registers.

note: Commercial register is mentioned only in passing as a place where the address applies; nothing on its digital status.

facts.fact: LANA reports the head of Libya's Commercial Registry Authority told a meeting of branch managers that the digital transformation plan is still being completed, including electronic linking of all regional branches and e-archiving of company files in every branch.

systems.owner: Commercial Registry Authority, Ministry of Economy and Trade

note: The online service issues a letter confirming a registered company's data; it does not register firms online.
Document states nothing this study asks.
The document states nothing this study asks for the country.
Says registration needs a physical address; no digital register stated.
The document covers online certificates of origin issued by the chambers union, not company registration or any question of this study.

facts.fact: Libya's Ministry of Economy and Trade announced a pilot launch of an electronic registration system for branches of foreign companies, built by the Economic Information and Documentation Centre, with seven stages, 11 sectors and licences up to five years, before full operation.
facts.system: electronic registration system for branches of foreign companies

systems.system: Electronic registration system for foreign company branches
systems.owner: Ministry of Economy and Trade; built by Economic Information and Documentation Centre
Libya Post / Ministry of Economy and Trade

note: A planned company postal-address project linked to the commercial register; says nothing on online registration or digitising the register.
